qualification.details: Junior Technical Superintendent-Centre for Quantum Science & Technologies: First class Bachelor's/ Bachelor's (Honours) Degree in Physics/ Electronics or equivalent grade from a recognized University/Institute with minimum 5 years of experience OR First class Diploma in Electronics with excellent academic record with minimum 5 years' experience. Junior Technical Superintendent-Indian Knowledge system and Mental Health Applications: First class Bachelor's/ Bachelor's (Honours) Degree in Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery or equivalent grade from a recognized University/Institute with minimum 5 years of experience OR Post-graduate Degree in Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery from a recognized University or Institute with 2 years' experience. Junior Technical Superintendent-Digital & Computing Services (Software Development & Automation): First class Bachelor's/ Bachelor's (Honours) Degree in CS/IT or equivalent grade from a recognized University/Institute with minimum 5 years of experience OR First class Diploma in CSE/IT with excellent academic record with minimum 5 years' experience OR Post-graduate Degree in CS/IT with 2 years' experience OR B.E./ B.Tech. in CSE/IT or MCA from a recognized University or Institute with one-year experience. Junior Technical Superintendent-Digital & Computing Services (Network & system Administration): First class Bachelor's/ Bachelor's (Honours) Degree in CS/IT/Electronics or equivalent grade from a recognized University/Institute with minimum 5 years of experience OR First class Diploma in CSE/IT/ECE with excellent academic record with minimum 5 years' experience OR Post-graduate Degree in CS/IT/Electronics with 2 years' experience OR B.E./ B.Tech. in CSE/IT/ECE or MCA from a recognized University or Institute with one-year experience. Staff Nurse: Intermediate or 10+2 or Equivalent with 3 years diploma in General Nursing and Mid-wifery. Registration with Nursing Council. 1 year experience in a hospital recognized by the Central or State Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Mandi Non-Teaching Positions?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the IIT Mandi Non-Teaching Positions is 24th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Non-Teaching Positions at IIT Mandi?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies for Non-Teaching Positions at IIT Mandi, including various Superintendent roles and Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification generally requires a Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field, along with specified years of experience, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for most positions is 35 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these Non-Teaching Positions?
faq.answer: The positions are offered at Pay Level-06, indicating a competitive salary structure as per IIT Mandi norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Mandi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee that varies based on the category. Unreserved/EWS candidates need to pay Rs. 500/-, OBC candidates Rs. 400/-, and SC/ST/Women/PwD/ESM candidates Rs. 300/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Non-Teaching Positions?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a screening, skill test, or written test, followed by the final selection process.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Himachal Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Himachal Pradesh, but it is advisable to check the detailed eligibility criteria in the official notification for any specific residency requirements.

faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of IIT Mandi or the provided application portal before the closing date.
